tools.name: analyze_code
tools.description: Analyze code for security issues, errors, deceptive patterns, and placeholders. Returns a structured analysis with issues and strengths.

filename.description: The filename (used to detect language). Example: 'app.ts'

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Analyze code and generate a detailed HTML report with visual indicators for issues and strengths.

filename.description: The filename (used to detect language). Example: 'app.ts'

tools.name: check_security
tools.description: Check code for security vulnerabilities only (hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, XSS, etc.)

tools.name: check_deceptive_patterns
tools.description: Check for code patterns that hide errors or create false confidence (empty catches, silent failures, etc.)

tools.name: check_placeholders
tools.description: Check for placeholder code, dummy data, TODO/FIXME comments, and incomplete implementations

tools.name: analyze_patterns
tools.description: Analyze code for architectural, design, and implementation patterns. Detects pattern usage, inconsistencies, and provides actionable suggestions for improvement.

level.description: Pattern level to analyze: 'architectural' (system structure), 'design' (GoF patterns), 'code' (implementation idioms), or 'all' (default)

query.description: Optional natural language query to focus analysis (e.g., 'how is error handling done?')

tools.name: analyze_design_patterns
tools.description: Focused analysis of Gang of Four (GoF) design patterns in code. Detects Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy, and other classic patterns with confidence levels and implementation details.
